properties.title: Flood Advisory issued October 17 at 7:56PM CDT until October 19 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in Texas...
Oklahoma...

Red River near Burkburnett affecting Jefferson, Wichita, Cotton,
Clay and Tillman Counties.

For the Upper Red River...including Burkburnett, Terral,
Gainesville...elevated river levels are forecast.

* WHERE...Red River near Burkburnett.

* WHEN...Until late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet, Near bankfull conditions extend along the
Red River near Davidson... Oklahoma downstream to areas near
Burkburnett and Taylor... Oklahoma.

- Bankfull stage is 9.0 feet.

evening.

- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 17 at 8:54PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor is forecast to remain in Minor Flood
Stage through Sunday, but strong northeasterly winds will slow river
flow leading to a quick rise in levels. The river is forecast to
reach Moderate Flood Stage early Monday, with a steady increase
through Moderate Flood Stage forecast through the week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with
several inches of water inside homes along the river and canals.
Docks at Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely
submerged. Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with
yards completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads
flooded in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on
Juno Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 2.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Saturday was 2.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to 3.3 feet Tuesday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 1100 AM EDT.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued October 17 at 8:41PM EDT until October 17 at 9:30PM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
SMWKEY

The National Weather Service in Key West has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Bay and Gulf Side from Craig Key to Halfmoon Shoal out to 5
fathoms...

* Until 930 PM EDT.

* At 841 PM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located near Content Keys,
moving east at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

* Locations in the warning include...
Content Keys and Horseshoe Key.
properties.instruction:
Boaters should seek safe harbor as quickly, and as safely as
possible. When downpours reduce visibility, slow down.
properties.area: Bayside and Gulfside from Craig Key to West End of Seven Mile Bridge; Gulf of America from West End of Seven Mile Bridge to Halfmoon Shoal out to 5 Fathoms

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 17 at 2:12PM CDT until October 20 at 7:32PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Beaver Creek near Electra affecting Wilbarger and Wichita Counties.

For the Beaver Creek (NW TX)...including Electra...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Beaver Creek near Electra.

* WHEN...From Sunday evening to Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 26.0 feet, Flood levels up to 2 feet in depth cover
farm and range lands... and may inundate some oil and gas
facilities... along and near the creek in southern Wilbarger County
and southwestern Wichita County.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1:00 PM CDT Saturday the stage was 17.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 24.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
tomorrow evening to a crest of 25.6 feet early Monday afternoon.
It will then fall below flood stage early Tuesday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 24.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.7
feet on 10/14/2018.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 215 AM CDT.
